sh: line of riders on galloping horses, bugle and sabres
f: Here comes the cavalry. Hold on to your hat.

sh: front rank of heavy shields advancing with a red banner
f: First in. Loudest. Shiniest.

sh: small helmeted trooper with an oversized pack
f: Does the work. Gets none of the medals.

sh: goggled trooper with a sack of round cartoon bombs
f: Counts to three. Sometimes two.

sh: big hairy ape, long arms, knuckle-walking, chest thump
f: Monkey see. Ape SMASH.

sh: straight golden beam of light with sparkles
f: A little ray of sunshine. In your eyes.

sh: feathered dino, sickle toe claw, long stiff tail
f: Tested the fences. Found your keyboard.

sh: six-legged bug, antennae, shiny green shell
f: Six legs. Zero respect for picnics.

sh: scruffy little furball with bright eyes and a twitchy nose
f: Lives in your walls. Pays no rent.

sh: mystery mix: stripes, spots, antlers and a wagging tail
f: Which animal? Yes.

sh: fluffy friendly thing with a collar, tag and leash
f: Who is a good summon? YOU are. Yes you are.

sh: warm furry four-legger with whiskers and a milk bottle
f: Warm-blooded, fuzzy, proud of both.

sh: scaly green sunbather with a flicking tongue
f: Cold-blooded. Warm rock. Do not disturb.

sh: slimy smooth-skinned hopper, half in a puddle
f: Land AND water. Could not pick. Did both.

sh: sleek stalking hunter, low crouch, glowing eyes
f: You are not at the top of this food chain.

sh: wide-eyed fluffy thing, ears up, frozen mid-hop
f: Runs first. Thinks later. Lives longer.

sh: scurrying pack of scruffy grey nibblers
f: If you see one, there are forty.

sh: cow, sheep and pig trotting together behind a fence
f: The whole farm showed up. Even the goat.

sh: wide wave of galloping hooves and horns in dust
f: One got spooked. Now it is everyone's problem.

sh: swirling V of small birds, feathers drifting
f: Birds of a feather attack together.

sh: five grey wolves fanning out, leader howling
f: Hunts as one. Argues about dinner as five.

sh: dense black-and-yellow buzzing cloud, shifting shape
f: Bzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzz. Run.

sh: striped papery dome dripping honey, bees circling
f: Do not poke it. Somebody always pokes it.

sh: sandy mound with endless columns of marching ants
f: A million tiny workers. No coffee breaks.

sh: basket spilling six wobbly puppies and kittens
f: Seven tiny chaos units in a basket.

sh: droopy-eared tracking dog, nose to the ground
f: Has your scent. Has always had your scent.

sh: golden fluffy dog with a ball, tail a blur
f: Brings it back. Will not let go. Classic.

sh: rearing wild horse, back legs kicking high
f: Eight seconds. That is all anyone gets.

sh: cutaway bedroom box: bed, posters, clothes mountain
f: Clean it. No, really. There is a smell.

sh: round brass knob with a keyhole
f: Opens doors. Closes arguments.

sh: wide wooden floorboards tilting like a seesaw
f: The floor is the floor. That is worse.

sh: white ceiling slab with a wobbling light, dropping
f: Look up. Too late.

sh: long narrow passage, endless doors, flickering light
f: Somehow longer at night.

sh: wooden drawer shooting open, socks and batteries flying
f: Contains one of everything except what you need.

sh: white bedsheet billowing with two eye holes
f: Either laundry or a ghost. Fifty-fifty.

sh: bristly brown mat reading WELCOME, whipped out from under
f: Says welcome. Means trip.

sh: framed photo with a blinding flash, awkward smiles
f: Say cheese. Everyone blinked.

sh: curling band poster, tape on corners
f: Covers the hole in the wall. And the enemy.

sh: ticking wristwatch with a spinning second hand
f: Look at the time. Yours is up.

sh: wall calendar ripping off pages that fly like blades
f: Is it Monday already? It is always Monday.

sh: chrome tap with a twisty handle gushing water
f: Drip. Drip. Drip. All night. Drip.

sh: squeezy bottle spurting bubbly foam
f: Lather. Rinse. Repeat. Forever. Help.

sh: heap of black bags, banana peels, fish bones, flies
f: One person's trash is still trash.

sh: teetering mountain of socks, shirts and one sneaker
f: The pile grew again. It is breathing now.

sh: clear shiny pane with glints, cracks spreading
f: You walked into it. Everyone does.

sh: spinning white plate with a blue rim
f: It is your turn to do them. Throw instead.

sh: red and white striped bendy straw slurping
f: Sllluuurp. That was your health bar.

sh: folded white napkin flapping like a swan
f: Folded into a swan. The swan is angry.

sh: tangled loop of string knotting itself
f: How long is it? Long enough to trip you.

sh: scatter of sharp thumbtacks, points up
f: Left on the chair by an expert.

sh: flat black pad with glowing RGB edge
f: Gamer shield. Wrist support included.

sh: two tiny white buds with a hopelessly tangled wire
f: Tangled in your pocket by dark magic.

sh: three-prong plug and a wall socket with a surprised face
f: Do not stick a fork in it. Seriously.

sh: chunky round dial turned all the way to 11
f: Turned up to eleven. The dial only goes to ten.

sh: metal pull handle attached to nothing
f: Get a grip. No, an actual grip.

sh: steel hex nut spinning like a tiny saw
f: Could be hardware. Could be a snack. Bite to find out.

sh: A-frame with a seat on chains at full arc
f: Higher! Higher! Too high! TOO HIGH!

sh: round wooden tub of bubbling steamy water
f: Too relaxed to fight. That is the trap.

sh: blue bin with three chasing arrows, cans leaping out
f: Your attack will return as a park bench.

sh: random falling junk: boot, lamp, fish, trophy, sock
f: What stuff? All of it. Incoming.

sh: lumpy mystery gadget with a crank, antenna and one eye
f: Nobody knows what it does. It does it well.

sh: combo tool: hammer one side, wrench the other
f: If it does not fit, hit it harder.

sh: wind-up tin robot, key in back, googly eyes, wobble walk
f: Batteries not included. Menace is.

sh: colourful bubble-pop square clicking nonstop
f: Click click click click click click click.

sh: classic red ball with a white stripe and shine
f: Boing. Boing. Boing. Bonk. Sorry!

sh: pair of purple inline skates with glowing wheels
f: Stopping was not in the lesson.

sh: pink teapot and cups pouring in mid-air
f: Pinkies up. Gloves off.

sh: hundreds of rainbow beads scattering across the floor
f: Spilled on purpose. Good luck walking.

sh: floating START button with pixels and a joystick
f: You lost the game. Sorry. Everyone just did.

sh: glowing screen spilling blocky pixels and a health bar
f: Just five more minutes. Said three hours ago.

sh: sleek black box with a glowing ring and two controllers
f: Overheats when winning. Suspicious.

sh: red and black discs hopping over each other
f: King me. Then duck.

sh: glinting foil card spinning like a blade
f: Mint condition. Do NOT bend it.

sh: gold ribboned box on a pedestal, spotlight
f: You won! Terms and explosions apply.

sh: rows of desks, chalkboard, thirty raised hands
f: Pop quiz. Sit down. Eyes forward.

sh: towering paper stack with a red F and a chewed pencil
f: The dog refuses to eat this much.

sh: sheet of bubbles and questions, big red question mark
f: Question one: did you study? Thought not.

sh: big red letter F in a circle, flying like a stamp
f: See me after class.

sh: droning wave of chalk dust, numbers and Zs
f: And THAT is why... zzz... the mitochondria...

sh: brown paper bag with a sandwich, apple and juice box
f: Trade you my apple for your cookies.

sh: falling numbers, plus signs, fractions and a pi
f: If a train leaves at 3, you lose at 3:01.

sh: bubbling green flask orbited by an atom symbol
f: It works in theory. Stand back anyway.

sh: dusty scroll unrolling, tiny knights and pyramids on it
f: Doomed to repeat it. Again.

sh: giant red pen, flying commas and apostrophes
f: Its "you're", not "your". Take that.

sh: rainbow paint splatter with brushes and a gold frame
f: My kid could do that. Your kid did.

sh: open book with glowing words drifting upward
f: One more chapter. One more. One more.

sh: looping blue ink scrawl chasing a pen tip
f: Even the doctor cannot read this.

sh: scrambled letter tiles with red squiggly underlines
f: Speling. Spelking. Splelling. Close enough.

sh: bright block letters A to Z tumbling down
f: Now I know my ABCs. Now they hurt.

sh: bouncing chunky digits 0 to 9 with a floating +1
f: Pick a number. Wrong. It was seven.

sh: glowing speech bubble with WORD written inside
f: You typed word. Bold. Very meta.

sh: long line of words ending in a heavy full stop
f: Ends with a period. So do you.

sh: open storybook with a pop-up castle and a tiny dragon
f: Once upon a time, you lost. The end.

sh: wall of dense typed text, word count at the bottom
f: In conclusion: no.

sh: stapled pages in a plastic folder, pie chart on front
f: Double-spaced. Due yesterday.

sh: cardboard volcano with glitter and tri-fold display board
f: One kid did all the work. It was not this one.

sh: huge heavy map book open to a fold-out world
f: You are here. Would you like to be elsewhere?

sh: rolled parchment tied with a red ribbon, gold seal
f: Officially qualified to bonk.

sh: shower of square caps with swinging gold tassels
f: Caps go up. Caps come down. Mind your head.

sh: white gloopy dollop with a purple glue-stick cap
f: Somebody in class eats this. You know who.

sh: single lined page fluttering edge-first
f: Paper cut. The worst cut.

sh: red ribbon bookmark with a tassel
f: Saves your place. Loses the enemy's.

sh: flying buffet: drumstick, pizza slice, apple, cheese wedge
f: Food fight! Nobody is clean. Nobody is sorry.

sh: loaded tray: burger, fries, drink and a tiny toy
f: Comes with a toy. The toy bites.

sh: plate of eggs and bacon making a smiley face, toast, juice
f: The most important summon of the day.

sh: steaming roast on a plate with peas and a dinner bell
f: DINNER! Wash your hands! Stop fighting!

sh: little pile of crackers, cheese cubes and grapes
f: Not hungry. Just snacky.

sh: sundae glass with cake slice, cherry and a spoon
f: There is always room. A separate stomach.

sh: bone-shaped biscuit with a sparkle
f: Sit. Stay. Betray your master.

sh: cartoon bone-in meat chunk, marbled red and white
f: Every carnivore in range just looked up.

sh: golden crispy lumps raining with a dip tub
f: A ten piece. For ten problems.

sh: puff of red-orange powder from a shaker
f: A little kick. Then a big one.

sh: glossy red puddle with a squeezy bottle squirting
f: The secret is more sauce. It is always more sauce.

sh: bowl of creamy dip with one broken chip stuck in
f: Double dippers will be prosecuted.

sh: sprinkle of golden crumbs trailing off
f: In the bed. In the keyboard. Forever.

sh: flying egg, flour puff, butter block and whisk
f: Some assembly required.

sh: splattered recipe card with floating measuring spoons
f: Step one: preheat the battlefield.

sh: wobbly pale-yellow slippery blob with a shine
f: Slippery when existing.

sh: pointy crisp cone, pink scoop sliding off
f: Pointy end out. Sprinkles optional.

sh: floppy pink meat disc with a smiley face bitten in
f: That is a load of baloney. Catch.

sh: blizzard of envelopes and pop-ups shouting YOU WON
f: Congratulations! You are the 1,000,000th victim!

sh: empty outfit walking by itself: shirt, jeans, sneakers
f: Nobody inside. Still better dressed than you.

sh: flapping red t-shirt with a pizza stain
f: Inside out and backwards. Like always.

sh: pair of brown trousers running with no owner
f: Ran off without you. Again.

sh: stiff blue jeans standing up on their own, ripped knee
f: So stiff they stand up alone.

sh: bright Hawaiian shorts sprinting on invisible legs
f: Knees out. Speed up.

sh: pink skirt twirling like a spinning top
f: Twirl defence. Surprisingly solid.

sh: sharp empty suit with a red tie adjusting its cuffs
f: Dressed to impress. And to distress.

sh: chunky knit cardigan with big wooden buttons
f: Smells like biscuits. Blocks like a wall.

sh: one flying sneaker, laces trailing, stink lines
f: Thrown with love. And accuracy.

sh: spinning flip-flop curving through the air
f: Never misses. Mothers have trained for this.

sh: dark pulled-up hood with only two eyes visible
f: Hood up. Mystery on.

sh: huge shiny rodeo buckle spinning
f: Bigger than the belt. Bigger than the cowboy.

sh: line of metal teeth zipping the ground shut
f: Zip it. Literally.

sh: denim pocket spilling lint, coins, a frog and a key
f: Contains lint, a frog and your lunch money.

sh: long floppy purple sleeve with aces and scarves poking out
f: Always something up it.

sh: half dinosaur, half astronaut suit with a wonky zip
f: Who are you supposed to be? Exactly.

sh: crisp blazer, tie and shiny shoes marching in step
f: Tuck your shirt in. This is war.

sh: small bib with a duck on it, covered in mashed carrot
f: Catches everything. Even fireballs. Mostly peas.

sh: stripy swimsuit doing a perfect cannonball
f: Last one in is a rotten egg.

sh: spilling heap of rings, chains and glittering gems
f: Ooh, shiny. That was the trap.

sh: drifting gauzy see-through curtain of lace
f: Now you see me. Now you kind of see me.

sh: denim dungarees with a wrench in one pocket, straw in other
f: One strap down. Maximum farmer.

sh: stretchy black leggings mid-lunge
f: Stretchy. Unstoppable. Very comfy.

sh: swishy neon jacket puffed up by the wind
f: Swish swish swish. Stealth: zero.

sh: puffy round snowsuit, arms stuck straight out
f: Cannot put arms down. Cannot be hurt either.

sh: neon zip pouch on a belt, snacks and maps poking out
f: Dad is prepared for anything. Anything.

sh: generic boxy buggy with mismatched wheels and one headlight
f: It has wheels. Probably. Get in.

sh: runaway rubber wheel with a silver hubcap, rolling fast
f: Reinvented. Now with more rolling over you.

sh: chunky revving engine block, shaking, pipes blasting flame
f: VROOM. Just the vroom. No car.

sh: red pedal stomp with screeching skid marks
f: SCREEEECH. Everyone stops. Coffee spills.

sh: foot flooring a pedal, flames from behind
f: Pedal to the metal. Metal to the wall.

sh: pair of blinding round car lights, deer frozen in them
f: Deer in the headlights. You are the deer.

sh: padded seat with an ejector spring underneath
f: Sit down. Buckle up. Eject.

sh: grey strap with a red buckle snapping tight
f: Click it or get clicked.

sh: red jerry can glugging a rainbow-sheen puddle
f: Smells like road trips. Burns like regret.

sh: falling rack of swords, axes, maces and a rubber chicken
f: Which weapon? All of them. At once.

sh: chunky orange-tipped cartoon blaster, round barrel
f: Pew pew. The pews are included.

sh: snub-nosed cartoon bullet with angry eyebrows
f: Has places to be. Mostly through things.

sh: bare gleaming blade, no handle, light glint
f: Careful. It is all edge.

sh: plain grey metal bar humming with static
f: Simple. Straight. Extremely bonk.

sh: very long bendy pole, vaulting arc
f: Would not touch you with a ten-foot one. Oh wait.

sh: neon paint pellet bursting into a bright splat
f: Stings a bit. Stains forever.

sh: thin bamboo tube puffing a red-feathered dart
f: Pfft. Night night.

sh: row of sharp steel cones popping up from a floor plate
f: Every platformer's favourite surprise.

sh: long angled barrel on two wheels with a trail spade
f: Knocks politely from three miles away.

sh: pointy silver nose cone with a red tip and hazard stripes
f: The pointy bit is the important bit.

sh: bundle of red sticks with a ticking clock and wires
f: Red wire or blue wire? Wrong.

sh: rolled-up glossy magazine swatting down
f: Rolled up. The ancient bug-swatting art.

sh: leather hip holster, hand hovering, tumbleweed
f: Draw! No, not with crayons.

sh: long leather sword sleeve with brass tip
f: The sword's house. Also bonks.

sh: red circle with a plus sign locking on, beeping
f: Locked on. Do not move. You moved.

sh: black tube lens with a blue glint, zooming in
f: Sees you from three maps away.

sh: red horned brute, bat wings, tail, flaming pitchfork
f: Works in the underworld. Hates the commute.

sh: red trickster, tiny horns, goatee, pointed tail, pitchfork
f: Makes deals. Read the small print. Too late.

sh: vast robed figure of light in clouds, beard, raised hand
f: Moves in mysterious ways. Mostly downward. On you.

sh: radiant towering woman, star crown, flowing gown of light
f: Graceful. Glorious. Out of patience.

sh: muscular hero with glowing eyes, half a toga, lion pelt
f: Half god. Half human. Full show-off.

sh: tall black-robed figure, hood, bony hand, hourglass
f: Very patient. Has all the time. Especially yours.

sh: lumpy green thing, three eyes, one giant arm, extra tail
f: Fell in the goo. Came out improved. Sort of.

sh: three snowballs, carrot nose, top hat, stick arms, scarf
f: Carrot nose. Coal eyes. Cold heart.

sh: cracked glowing pit, flames, rising smoke and red rock
f: Warm all year. Terrible reviews.

sh: round corked bottle of swirling purple liquid, tiny stars
f: Cures everything. Tastes like purple.

sh: shower of coins, gems, a glowing sword and a boot
f: Legendary drop! It is a boot. One boot.

sh: floating yellow exclamation mark over a scroll
f: Collect ten bear pelts. No reason given.

sh: misty purple scroll-shaped cloud with shadowy beasts inside
f: Nobody has seen it. Everybody knows a guy.

sh: red-bearded Norse giant, winged helm, short stone hammer
f: Old Norse weather forecast: hammer.

sh: one-eyed old wanderer, wide hat, spear, two ravens
f: Traded an eye for wisdom. Still lost his keys.

sh: white-bearded giant on a cloud throne hurling lightning
f: Throws lightning first. Asks questions never.

sh: sea-green bearded giant, seaweed crown, golden trident, wave
f: Rules the sea. Bad at sharing it.

sh: pale gloomy king, blue flame hair, robe, two-prong staff
f: Runs the basement. Never gets visitors who leave.

sh: bronze-armoured giant, red crest helm, spear, round shield
f: Started this fight. Starts all of them.

sh: tall woman in a plumed helm, owl on shoulder, spear, shield
f: Wisdom AND a spear. Unfair, honestly.

sh: golden youth with a laurel crown, sun disc, bow and lyre
f: Hot. Knows it. Brought a lyre to prove it.

sh: slim runner, winged sandals, winged cap, snake staff
f: Delivery in zero seconds or your prayers back.

sh: mega-muscled hero in a lion skin swinging an olive-wood club
f: Twelve labours done. Yours is number thirteen.

sh: black jackal-headed figure, gold collar, scales and crook
f: Weighs your heart. Yours is heavy on snacks.

sh: falcon-headed god with a blazing red sun disc on his head
f: Two letters. One sun. No mercy.

sh: green-skinned wrapped king, tall white crown, crook, flail
f: Came back from the dead. Did not make it weird.

sh: grinning red-haired trickster, fur cloak, flickering copies
f: It was not him. It is never him. It was him.
